title: Customer Churn Prediction Signal
scenario: Find users who decreased their subscription tier twice in a row.
tableSchema: sub_tier (user_id INT, tier INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Compare current tier with previous and before-previous tier using LAG(tier, 2).
correctQuery: SELECT user_id FROM (SELECT user_id, tier, LAG(tier) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY change_date) as prev1, LAG(tier, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY change_date) as prev2 FROM sub_tier) t WHERE tier < prev1 AND prev1 < prev2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sub_tier (user_id INT, tier INT, change_date DATE);
